item.title: Godsmack Announce “Live At The Mohegan Sun” Releasing via Primary Wave
item.description: Godsmack will release Live at Mohegan Sun on May 1, a high‑voltage live album captured during the band’s sold‑out October 26, 2024 performance at Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut.
